name: capacitor-iap-bridge
description: Local, app-only Capacitor plugin: wraps StoreKit 2 for the native in-app tip jar. Not published — used only via the file: dependency in this repo's root package.json so `npx cap sync` can discover it and manage its native registration automatically instead of that being hand-maintained. The Android half of the tip jar is a separate, hand-registered plugin directly in android/app/ (see IAPBridgePlugin.java there) rather than a package like this one, since this repo has no existing Capacitor-package-style Android module and no Kotlin toolchain yet — see PROJECT_HANDOFF.md.
